album.title: Maestro Ahmad Ebadi: Lord of Setar

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on B3 and dwells most on E in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:06.9) introduces E, centred on E. Phrase 3 (0:40.8) introduces Gb, centred on E. Phrase 4 (1:07.3) introduces G, A, centred on A. The line peaks at A4 (439.3 Hz) at 1:15.3. It closes on G4, not the tonic (Gb4 → G4 → G4 → Gb4 → G4 → G4).
